rows.traditional: 對 A 有負面影響
rows.jyutping: deoi3 A jau5 fu6 min2 jing2 hoeng2
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction when something negatively affects a person, thing, or outcome.

example.english: This report negatively affects the company.
example.traditional: 呢份報告對公司有負面影響。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 deoi3 gung1 si1 jau5 fu6 min2 jing2 hoeng2

rows.note: Use this when someone answers a question with “no,” rather than describing a harmful or unfavorable effect.

example.english: They asked whether I wanted to eat, and I answered negatively.
example.jyutping: keoi5 man6 ngo5 sik6 m4 sik6 ngo5 daap3 m4
